QuestInfo.name: The Erstwhile Vault
QuestInfo.0: A grand entrance will get you a long way, but you're nowhere near as powerful as you once were. Not to worry, with a little practice, you'll be back on your feet in no time.
QuestInfo.1: The first step is to reawaken the skills you used hundreds of years ago, when you were known as the Master Thief. That means you'll need access to your secret vault #b#m200000000# Cloud Park II#k. That's the quickest path to your 2nd Job Advancement.
QuestInfo.2: The vault seems to be free of any lockpicks or trespassers. Not that anyone else could get inside. This is a vault for a true master.

0.0: For some reason, I remember it taking a lot longer to get to level 30 in the past. Maybe this new world is a much kinder place. Or maybe I'm just knocking the rust off of these old pipes.
0.1: I suppose it's about time for a 2nd Job Advancement. All these new people are going to expect a good show. Except...
0.2: I don't have a teacher anymore! Gaston's old, but not very useful in combat. Oh! My secret stash! My old documents should be there... if I can remember where is... or was. I wonder if #m200000000# still exists.
0.3: Ah, the difficulties of the fantastically wealthy. I have multiple vaults, so even I get confused from time to time. Let's head to the one in #m200000000# first.\r\n#e#b<You will be moved to #m200000000# #m200020001# if you accept.>#k#n\r\n

no.0: It's tough being the greatest thief in the history of the world. Nobody ever tells you what to do...

1.0: Wow. This world has not seen ONE decent treasure hunter in the time that I've been gone. I find that a little bit disappointing...
